Hyphenated. Bipolar kernel: 'corrupt' (moral, Pi-stem; Gen 6:11-12 'the earth was corrupt before God'), 'destroy / ruin' (physical, Hi-stem; Gen 6:13 'I will destroy them'), 'mar / spoil'. KJV/ESV split as 'corrupt / destroy / mar' contextually. Concordant 'corrupt-destroy' bridges both poles.

The noun-form preserves the legal-prosecutor / accuser kernel.
